name: Watcher of Hours
blocked_sentences: Whenever you remove a time counter from this card while it's exiled, surveil 1.

needs.what: a trigger event that fires each time a time counter is removed from this card while it is in exile (every suspend upkeep tick, the last one included), heard by an ability with active_zones ["exile"] and controlled by the card's owner; the engine already emits TIME_COUNTER_REMOVED from suspend.py, but no DSL trigger event exposes it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: trigger_events has `last_counter_removed`, which fires only when the final counter goes, not on each removal, and `counter_placed`, which is the opposite direction; there is no `counter_removed` / `time_counter_removed` event in reference, so a per-tick surveil from exile cannot be said
